title: Read unit references in text
responsibility: Recognizes unit-reference markers while preserving all surrounding and malformed text.

inputs.name: entityReferences.value
inputs.description: The original agent text to scan for complete [[unit:<id>]] markers. Only markers whose IDs match the lower-case dotted unit-ID grammar (maximum 200 characters) become references; invalid or unfinished markers remain text.

inputs.name: isUnitId.value
inputs.description: The candidate registry unit ID to validate. It must contain at least two lower-case dotted segments, each starting with a letter and continuing with letters, digits, or hyphens, and may be at most 200 characters; registration is not checked.

outputs.name: isUnitId
outputs.description: Whether the candidate matches the unit-ID grammar. A true result does not establish that the unit is registered.

outputs.name: entityReferences
outputs.description: The ordered text and reference parts produced from the input; concatenating each part's text reproduces the input exactly. A reference carries the validated unit ID and its complete original marker; input with no valid marker yields only text parts (or an empty array for empty input).
